findings.title: Hong Kong Monetary Authority and Bank Negara Malaysia Strengthen Bilateral Cooperation

rendered_html: 📔 Regulatory Bulletin — 7 October 2026 (Daily) Executive Summary • 🟡 HKMA and Bank Negara Malaysia have announced bilateral workstreams spanning cross-border stablecoin use cases, trade-finance data, cyber resilience and payment infrastructure. The announcement creates no authorised-institution requirement or timetable, but banks active in Hong Kong–Malaysia payments, SME trade finance or digital-asset initiatives may need to assess future interoperability, partner and control implications if pilots or specifications follow. Hong Kong 🟡 Hong Kong Monetary Authority and Bank Negara Malaysia Strengthen Bilateral Cooperation 🇭🇰 Item ID: item-20261006-hkma-press-ee036fdaa0 ⏰ Deadline: No source deadline stated Products: Cross-border payments, SME trade finance, digital assets The Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) and Bank Negara Malaysia announced bilateral collaboration after their 2 October meeting, including a policy-focused workstream on compliant cross-border stablecoin use cases. The announced areas also cover policy and regulatory exchange on tokenisation and digital money, knowledge sharing on CDI and CargoX to expand SME trade-finance access, cyber-resilience and anti-scam cooperation, RTGS connectivity, and exploration of a CMU–RENTAS central securities depository linkage. This is a bilateral cooperation announcement rather than a rule or supervisory expectation for authorised institutions, and the release states no participation mandate, technical specification, customer or data requirement, or implementation date. Banks active in the stated Hong Kong–Malaysia activities may need to monitor whether the workstreams produce pilots, standards or participation conditions that affect interoperability, customer/data flows, fraud and cyber controls, or partner arrangements. Source: Hong Kong Monetary Authority and Bank Negara Malaysia Strengthen Bilateral Cooperation Mainland/GBA No qualifying Mainland/GBA developments were included in this edition. SG/UK/GLOBAL Benchmark Comparable overseas developments and commercial/control benchmarks. They do not establish Hong Kong requirements. No qualifying benchmark developments were included in this edition. Watch List • Monitor HKMA and Bank Negara Malaysia publications for any pilot, specification, participation condition, implementation timetable or data-governance arrangement arising from the announced workstreams.
